title: Wordpiece-level latency SLI, failover heatmaps, and operational playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: We lack a reliable, low-noise pipeline for measuring inference latency at the granularity of wordpieces (sub-token steps) across regions and model variants. Current dashboards aggregate at request-level which hides amplification effects from KV-cache misses, early-exits, and re-tries. This impedes fast diagnosis during multi-region incidents and complicates dynamic circuit-breaker thresholds.

Goal: Implement a wordpiece-level SLI ingestion pipeline, expose golden signals (latency distribution, error rate, saturation) per-region/per-shard/per-model-variant, and ship Grafana dashboards + an operational playbook that ties SLI thresholds to adaptive circuit-breaker policies and load-shedding actions. Provide tooling for dependency mapping (which model variant and hardware class saw the degradation).

Success criteria: Low-noise, production-grade SLI with <5% additional overhead on RPC paths; dashboards showing p50/p90/p95/p99 of wordpiece emission latency, cache-miss attribution panels, and an easy link from any row to the incident runbook and failing task IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming pipeline emits wordpiece-level histograms to metrics backend (Prometheus/OTLP) without blocking serving threads
Grafana dashboards with per-region heatmaps for p50/p90/p95/p99 and a linked drill-down to sample traces
Circuit-breaker service consumes the new SLI stream and can evaluate adaptive thresholds in canary/production modes
Operational playbook (runbook) published in Confluence with clear thresholds, escalation steps, and rollback guidance
Synthetic traffic job updated to exercise KV-cache miss and early-exit scenarios and feeds into alerting burn rate tests
steps: Design metric schema: wordpiece latency buckets, tags: region, model_variant, shard_id, billing_tier, cache_hit=(true|false)
Add non-blocking instrumentation in runtime: sample wordpiece emission time and annotate traces with cache_hit flag
Integrate with OTLP exporter and ensure histograms are aggregated at ingestion layer (no cardinality explosion)
Create Grafana dashboards and panels; implement heatmaps and a compact summary row per-region
Wire circuit-breaker to new SLI stream; implement simulation mode to validate thresholds before enabling in production
Draft runbook and add playbook automations (Slack pager templates, incident checklist)
Run canary rollout for the dashboards and SLI consumers, validate overhead, then roll out globally
notes: Trade-offs: adding wordpiece-level metrics increases cardinality; mitigate by limiting tag cardinality and using aggregated histograms at the collector side.
Decision: prefer histogram+exemplar approach over per-wordpiece traces for production to control storage costs.
Fallback: if collection overhead exceeds 5% CPU at tail, fall back to sampled collection (1%) plus synthetic augmentation to fill histograms.
Privacy: metrics contain no user prompt text; ensure prompt IDs are hashed if used for correlation.
Related incident learnings: 2025-11 multi-region failover showed cache-miss amplification. Use frequency-weighted bucketing to surface this pattern.
